description: The workbook of docs/research/pivot-ui-probe, Part 1: a table with two table slicers that keep Excel's default settings. Sheet T holds the table Sales over A1:D7, the six records of probes/t4767-pivot-slicers (Region, Product, Date, Sales: East A 1, West A 2, East B 4, West B 8, North C 16, East C 32), a table slicer on Region at F3 and one on Product at I3. The slicer of that probe's sheet TS has crossFilter=none, which draws no button lighter; these two state no setting, so that a filter on one column shows how Excel draws the other's items with no data. It is not an eval case: no oracle fills it, and nothing scores it.
